transcription.text: We use water to wash our hands.
It comes from the tap too.
We use water to wash our hands.
We use water to wash vegetables and clothes too.
Farmers use water to grow crops.
Firemen use water to put out fires.
The Journey of Little Water Drop
1. Little Water Drop lives in the sea.
I want to be up in the sky, says Little Water Drop.
2. The sun shines and Little Water Drop gets hot.
He goes up to the sky.
Now he is in a cloud.
Hooray! I am up in the sky, he says happily.
3. Little Water Drop flies over rivers and mountains.
One day he sees some trees.
We need water, say the trees.
4. Little Water Drop falls down to the ground.
Now Little Water Drop is inside the tree.
The children are playing in the park.
They like this swing, they like that slide.
